reason: 已确认真实矿车 attachment 序列化、实际装配交互、服务端身份同步与客户端渲染消费，不以缺游戏运行或未读renderer作为否决理由。但当前增量仍是可选资源身份/type字段加显式none哨兵，在世界对象上恢复外观，未展示旧格式转换、已获资格/实体替换后的稳定玩家owner映射、材料付款/退还或跨载体托管协调。单凭另一种外观字段与serializer、再附network/render桥，不构成第951个相关玩法持久机制。作为已有身份/空值边界研究的支持保留，不新增计数。
findings: WrapperSerializer fresh wrapper 并恢复type；IE:NoShader只查存在，不查值/类型，且优先于同时存在的IE:Shader；缺type或缺shader且无none会进入ResourceLocation.parse，无局部fallback。
ShaderBanner缺compound时保留已有/构造wrapper，writer总写明确空身份；单个world owner不按banner/cart/item拆分。
onMinecartInteraction server从手持 IShaderItem 的getShaderName设实际attachment并发tracking同步；已读方法未扣物品也未查owner，不能称付费收藏/授权恢复。
MessageMinecartShaderSync server以当前世界entityID定位minecart，从真实attachment回复，忽略request shader；client写runtime ID keyed cache。持久资源ID与临时render cache应分开，packet/entityID/helper计0。
补读完整ShaderMinecartRenderer135行：cache取资源ID→ShaderRegistry.getShader(id,minecart)；unknown registry或无case时直接return。87-91 registry lookup不清理wrapper保存的原始合法ID，所以渲染无case不等于磁盘身份被改写。
渲染对模型层/颜色消费是外观，没观察到恢复新付费资格。对源码中的model part下标/缓存生命周期不做未实测故障断言。

bb766b1402d43f2efb3e Ars familiar是实体/玩家carrier和旧root/nested实际协调，并含cosmetic stack；本proposal没有此跨载体重建。
2277497966b30ed8abfb decorated pot存制作材料身份且真实返还材料；此处只设置可复用shader并渲染，无付费材料托管收据。
已有mimic、coffin dye、armor stand拒绝边界一致：纯外观可持久不等于新增相关进度/托管迁移机制。不是断言源实现与这些AST同构，也不借用全局helper当新计数。

comparison_ledger_rows.input: UUID-keyed stored moa entity/skin selection and optional halo/developer glow appearance
comparison_ledger_rows.output: fresh world owner reconstructs optional null identities/colors; registry skin lookup resolves stored ID without applying a new purchase/reward
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Read full PerkSavedData plus ServerPerkData registration/applyPerkWithVerification/getServerPerkData and overworld data bridge. Actual per-player selected cosmetics survive entity replacement in world SavedData. Three same-owner cosmetic maps one credit, not one per color/key.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Unknown skin resolves null, malformed player UUID aborts load. Consumer filters visibility using external User predicate but leaves underlying stored rows. Offline/unverified entitlement handling beyond that predicate not traced; not evidence account identities can be guessed.

comparison_ledger_rows.reason: Full readMimic/writeMimic methods only cosmetic/world block-state delegation, no paid inventory/player progress restoration proven; did not count generic block codec.
Full reader/writer restores coffin dye and lid animation, no owned progress/legacy item recovery. Missing dye chooses BLACK unlike initialized RED; cosmetic excluded.

comparison_ledger_rows.input: stable owner UUID, holder ID, nested persistent name/color/cosmetic stack plus legacy root color/cosmetic
comparison_ledger_rows.output: loads nested actual customization via codec, then reconciles entity data and player familiar cap; absent nested optional name/color/cosmetic defaults empty
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Read whole actual codec and reconciliation consumers. Different from already credited learned familiar unlock set: this owns per-familiar customization and optional physical cosmetic stack while summoned/returned. Sync helper not separately counted; actual persisted tag not network-only.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: Raw fromTag getOrThrow can fail, invalid holder tryParse null. Both root and nested cosmetic written, nested default EMPTY is nonnull and may override old root-only cosmetic; color only overrides if nonempty. Sync writes back player cap while init, relies owner online. Tick discards missing/off-dimension owner after20tick; no claim all familiar subclass extra data or whole player Clone.

comparison_ledger_rows.input: four positional ingredient registry IDs inside physical pot BlockEntityTag sherds list
comparison_ledger_rows.output: missing/null/wrongtype list gives four bricks; short list individual brick fallback; recipe embeds four supplied ingredient identities; dynamic drop consumer returns each recorded ingredient default stack
comparison_ledger_rows.preservation: Concrete crafted-material identity preservation, not cosmetic design or building production. Item/tile bridge and ordered recipe/drop contract read fully, one owner including nested load helper.
comparison_ledger_rows.application_limit: No arbitrary input stack NBT/count retained by design, IDs only; invalid ResourceLocation can throw, unknown registry uses registry default rather than opaque retain. LootTable actual dynamic-drop selection not deep read, so not claim every break returns four or exact preservation.

comparison_ledger_rows.reason: Complete FancyArmorStandEntity read save/load, variant bound in byId, left hand, pick and break own type/name; native gear inherited. Extra own fields mostly cosmetic/material-return wrapper, no new robust durable progression/custody implementation beyond native stand; no per-material references.

limits: 仅固定上游源码静态研究，没有游戏/原生NBT/attachment读盘运行。
没有读取完整NeoForge attachment engine、IEBaseBlockEntity磁盘桥、全部shader获得/复制/解锁逻辑。proposal的onItemPickup只读到163，不能外推整个拾取或收藏体系。
network注册/全局缓存清理和entityID复用生命周期未审，不把renderer cache当持久owner或已证明跨世界安全。
未观察旧格式迁移不等于整个IE项目没有迁移；结论只约束本proposal给出的链。
